art_instructions: Draw a medium shot at eye level showing the interior of the family house. The owl is perched on a low wooden chair at a small table, pecking at a piece of meat held in her talons. Her amber eyes are focused, and her small green scarf is neatly tucked. A plate with crumbs suggests she has nearly finished eating. In the background, sunlight filters through a window, casting a warm glow. The setting matches earlier scenes in the house: natural wood tones, soft green accents, and cream curtains. Ensure the owl’s posture reflects contentment and concentration. The composition keeps all elements within a child’s eye-level view, maintaining the cozy, grounded perspective.
